story.iWant: a properly structured Next.js project with all core dependencies configured
story.soThat: I have a solid foundation for building the Yamazumi application
story.tasks:
- Initialize Next.js 15 project with TypeScript (AC: Project structure) - Run `npx create-next-app@latest yamazumi --typescript --tailwind --app --eslint` - Verify Next.js 15 with App Router is configured - Verify TypeScript is enabled with proper tsconfig.json - Verify ESLint is configured with default rules - Verify Tailwind CSS is configured
- Create basic folder structure (AC: Basic folder structure) - Create `components/` directory for React components - Create `lib/` directory for utility libraries - Create `types/` directory for TypeScript type definitions - Create `store/` directory for Zustand state management (planned) - Create `hooks/` directory for custom React hooks (planned) - Verify `app/` directory exists (App Router)
- Set up code quality tools (AC: ESLint and Prettier) - Install Prettier: `npm install -D prettier` - Create `.prettierrc` config file - Create `.prettierignore` file - Add format script to package.json: `"format": "prettier --write ."` - Verify ESLint and Prettier work together (no conflicts)
- Create project documentation (AC: README with setup instructions) - Update README.md with project overview - Document setup commands (`npm install`, `npm run dev`) - Document folder structure and conventions - Document available npm scripts - Add link to architecture.md and PRD.md
- Verify project functionality (AC: All acceptance criteria) - Run `npm run dev` and verify server starts on port 3000 - Run `npm run build` and verify TypeScript compiles without errors - Run `npm run lint` and verify linting passes - Access http://localhost:3000 and verify default Next.js page renders - Verify hot reload works when editing files

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
**Given** I am starting a new project **When** I initialize the Next.js 15 project with TypeScript **Then** The project structure includes: - Next.js 15 with App Router configured - TypeScript configuration - ESLint and Prettier setup - Basic folder structure (app/, components/, lib/, types/) - Package.json with core dependencies listed - README with setup instructions
**And** The project can be started with `npm run dev` **And** TypeScript compilation succeeds without errors **And** Linting passes with default configuration

doc.title: Architecture - Project Initialization
doc.snippet: Command: `npx create-next-app@latest yamazumi --typescript --tailwind --app --eslint`. Establishes Next.js 15 with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and ESLint configured.

doc.title: Architecture - Project Structure
doc.snippet: Complete folder structure defined: app/ (Next.js App Router), components/ (React components by feature), lib/ (utilities), types/ (TypeScript), store/ (Zustand), hooks/, tests/ (unit and e2e). Material UI + Tailwind CSS hybrid approach.

doc.title: Architecture - Naming Conventions
doc.snippet: Files: Components PascalCase.tsx, Utilities camelCase.ts, Hooks use prefix. Code: Components PascalCase, Functions camelCase, Variables camelCase, Constants UPPER_SNAKE_CASE.

doc.title: Architecture - Technology Stack
doc.snippet: Next.js 15 (App Router), TypeScript, Material UI (MUI) + Tailwind CSS, Vitest (unit testing), Playwright (E2E testing), Zod (env validation).

doc.title: UX Design - Design System Foundation
doc.snippet: Material UI (MUI) as primary component library. Professional Blue theme (#2563eb primary, #64748b secondary). System font stack, 12-column grid, spacing based on 4px unit.

constraints.constraint: Must use Next.js 15 with App Router (ADR-001) - no Pages Router
TypeScript must be enabled - no JavaScript files in src
Use Material UI (MUI) + Tailwind CSS hybrid styling approach (ADR-002)
Follow naming conventions: PascalCase for components, camelCase for functions/variables, UPPER_SNAKE_CASE for constants
ESLint and Prettier must be configured and passing before story completion
Project structure must match architecture.md specification (app/, components/, lib/, types/, store/, hooks/, tests/)
Testing directories must be created (tests/unit/, tests/e2e/) even though test configuration happens in future stories
Prettier config: single quotes, 2-space indentation, semicolons, trailing commas, 100 char max line width

tests.standards: Testing frameworks per architecture.md: Vitest for unit tests (faster, better ESM support), Playwright for E2E tests (essential for video/Crypto). Test configuration will be added in future stories. For Story 1.1, create test directories (tests/unit/, tests/e2e/) but test setup happens later.
